name: Cyproheptadine
aliases: Dihexazin, Axoprol, Ciproheptadina, Cyproheptadin, Cyproheptadinum, cyproheptidine, Glutodina, Periactin®
summary: Cyproheptadine, sold under the brand name Periactin among others, is a first-generation antihistamine which is used to treat allergies. In addition, it has a number of off-label uses, such as treatment of serotonin syndrome, insomnia, and use as an appetite stimulant. The drug is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: Cyproheptadine is a potent antihistamine or inverse agonist of the histamine H1 receptor. It also has anticholinergic, antiserotonergic, antidopaminergic, and local anesthetic activities.
pharmacology.kind: First-generation antihistamine; Serotonin receptor antagonist; Antidopaminergic; Appetite stimulant

body.says: Faecal (2–20%; of which, 34% as unchanged drug) and renal (40%; none as unchanged drug)

uses.text: Cyproheptadine is used to treat allergic reactions (specifically hay fever). There is evidence supporting its use for allergies, but second generation antihistamines such as ketotifen and loratadine have shown equal results with fewer side effects.

summaryZh: 塞浦西他啶，或名賽庚啶 ，是第一代抗組織胺藥，具有抗乙醯膽鹼和局部麻醉的功能，也是兒童抗過敏藥水希普利敏的主要成分。
summaryZhHans: 塞浦西他啶，或名赛庚啶 ，是第一代抗组织胺药，具有抗乙酰胆碱和局部麻醉的功能，也是儿童抗过敏药水希普利敏的主要成分。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, increased appetite and weight gain, dry mouth and constipation. Large amounts can cause confusion, hallucinations, a racing heart and seizures, and children may become excited rather than sleepy.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括嗜睡、食慾增加與體重上升、口乾與便秘。大量使用可能造成意識混亂、幻覺、心跳過快與癲癇發作，兒童則可能變得興奮而不是想睡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括嗜睡、食欲增加与体重上升、口干与便秘。大量使用可能造成意识混乱、幻觉、心跳过快与癫痫发作，儿童则可能变得兴奋而不是想睡。

fact.en: Cyproheptadine has a three-ring core much like the tricyclic antidepressants, joined to a piperidine ring by a double bond. It was introduced by Merck in the early 1960s.
fact.zh: 塞浦西他啶的三環核心與三環抗憂鬱藥很像，並以一個雙鍵與哌啶環相連。它在 1960 年代初期由默克藥廠推出。
fact.zhHans: 塞浦西他啶的三环内核与三环抗忧郁药很像，并以一个双键与哌啶环相连。它在 1960 年代初期由默克药厂推出。
